issues.description: The golden/expert submission (golden/trojan_report.json) is REJECTED by the evaluator (SR1 and SR4 fail), per the differential test results. This means a correct, high-quality submission cannot pass the benchmark as currently configured — either the golden answer file's wording doesn't match the SR1 width-extraction regex (e.g. it may phrase the affected width in a way that also matches 8/16, or doesn't isolate '24' cleanly), or the SR1/SR2 regex patterns are too strict/brittle. This is a critical correctness bug: the task is unusable until the golden solution passes.
issues.evidence: differential.golden_run.stdout shows: '[TEST] FAIL: SR1: no finding's extracted affected-width value(s) equal exactly {24}...' and '[TEST] FAIL: SR4: no single finding simultaneously satisfies SR1+SR2+SR3...' with overall exit_code 1 and expected 'pass'.

issues.description: No mutants were provided/run to validate that each requirement's check actually discriminates correct from incorrect submissions. mutation_score is 0.0 and all 8 requirements (FR1-FR4, SR1-SR4) are marked untested/unproven, meaning the harness's discrimination power is entirely unverified beyond the one golden and one naive-baseline run.
issues.evidence: validation report: 'mutation_score': 0.0, 'mutation_score_meaningful': false, 'untested_requirements': ['FR1','FR2','FR3','FR4','SR1','SR2','SR3','SR4'], and issues list includes 'golden_rejected' plus 8 'untested_requirement' entries.

issues.description: The golden answer file referenced by the differential harness is not included in the provided artifact bundles (only the naive empty baseline submission/trojan_report.json is shown). Without inspecting its exact text, it's impossible to confirm whether the SR1/SR2 regexes are miscalibrated or the golden file itself is poorly worded, but either way the mismatch must be fixed before this case is usable.
issues.evidence: expert_files: ['golden/trojan_report.json'] is referenced in the validation report but not present in the case_files or bundles supplied for analysis.

recommendations: Fix the golden/trojan_report.json fixture and/or the SR1 numeric-width-extraction regex so that the expert/correct answer passes SR1 (and consequently SR4) — verify by re-running the differential harness until golden_run.status == 'pass'.

Add mutant submissions (e.g. mutant_sr1_constant_change_width16, mutant_sr2_domain_specific_wrong_trigger_pattern, mutant_fr4_assignment_removal_unconditional_claim, and similar targeted mutants for FR1-FR3) and re-run mutation testing to raise mutation_score above 0 and confirm each requirement actually discriminates correct vs. incorrect submissions.

Double check the SR1 regex against realistic golden-quality phrasing (e.g. 'WIDTH parameter set to 24', '24-bit width configuration') to ensure it doesn't spuriously also capture DEPTH_LOG2 numeric values or other adjacent digits as false affected-width hits.
Re-run the full differential (golden vs. naive baseline) after fixes and confirm golden exits 0 while naive baseline exits non-zero, per the submission contract.
